feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 23 October 2026 5:32am
items.description:
##Today##

Heavy rain at first with a risk of localised flooding, turning lighter around lunchtime before gradually clearing later in the afternoon. Dry overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 7°C and max. air temperature 11°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

5-15


##Wind Speed##

30


##Wind Direction##

NW


##Wind##

North 15-20, 20-25 in places, increasing NW 25-30 gusts 40 during morning, 35 gusts 45-50 in places. Decreasing West or NW 15-20 during evening/ early part of night, 20-25 in places, then West or SW 15 overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate at times in rain at first, otherwise good. Patchy hill fog at first.


##Comments##

Risk of localised flooding at first. Strong winds until later, with gales in exposed spots for a time.


##Tomorrow##

Heavy rain will arrive in the morning as gales develop, the rain clearing to isolated showers in the evening. Severe gales later in day/ overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 8°C and max. air temperature 14°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

15-30


##Wind Speed##

40


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW 15 backing South and increasing 30-40 gusts 50-60 through the morning, veering West or SW later in day, then becoming West 40-50 with gusts 60-70 overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor in rain, becoming good later. Hill fog for a time.


##Comments##

Severe gales, with travel disruption and some damage. Heavy rain, risk localised flooding. Coastal overtopping at high tide (approx. 10:55 & 23:00).


##Sunday, 25 October 2026##

Sunny intervals and isolated showers. The severe gales at first very gradually easing.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 8°C and max. air temperature 12°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-1


##Wind Speed##

35


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

West 40-50 gusts 60-70 at first, gradually decreasing 25-30 gusts 40-45 by the evening, then backing South or SW 15 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Comments##

Severe gales at first, but winds will gradually ease through the period. Coastal overtopping at high tide (approx. 10:25 & 22:45).


##Monday, 26 October 2026##

Rain soon arriving, clearing later in day/ overnight. Windy again later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 8°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

5-10


##Wind Speed##

35


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW 15, gradually increasing South or SW 30-40 gusts 45-55 later in day, veering West overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain. Hill fog developing.


##Comments##

Gales developing later in day. Coastal overtopping at high tide (approx. 11:00 & 23:25).


##Tuesday, 27 October 2026##

Sunny/ clear intervals and isolated showers. Windy.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 13°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-2


##Wind Speed##

35


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

West 30-40 gusts 45-55, gradually decreasing West or SW 20-25, 25-30 gusts 40 in places.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Comments##

Gales at first, then strong winds. Coastal overtopping at high tide (approx. 11:35 & 00:05).
